author: Trash Theory
description:
As you might know, Courtney Love is a controversial figure. She fronted trailblazing alt rockers Hole, racked up Modern Rock Radio hallmarks like “Violet”, “Miss World” and “Celebrity Skin”. However most know her for her famous husband and or her contentious public persona. And because of that she’s accrued an array of enemies, and some of those enemies have written songs to express their complicated feelings. Nearly eight years ago I talked about how “I’ll Stick Around”, “Hollaback Girl” and a few other alternative hits are probably about her. Well here’s the sequel: These are some more songs that are maybe, probably about Courtney Love.

#courtneylove  #alternativerock  #musicdocumentary
